plugin.name: Gemini CLI
plugin.description: Google's Gemini CLI as a coding agent, for Gemini Code Assist plans.
plugin.longDescription: Adds Gemini CLI to Settings → Agents, beside Claude Code and Codex. Install it, sign in by running `gemini`, then turn it on in Settings → Agents; OhMyGame reads its models from the agent. Gemini CLI is for Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise plans and paid Gemini API keys; personal Google accounts use Antigravity CLI.
